When her father died in an accident and her mother fell ill, Sabina visited the Duchess Charlotte with her father’s keepsake.
“Why should I?”
“I am the only child left by the Duke’s brother.”
Thus, Sabina, in exchange for entering the mansion, decided to cut off all ties from the past and live as Princess Charlotte.
‘The problem is that I’m destined to be killed by the psychopathic male lead!’
There was only one way to survive, and she must avoid him at all costs!
With all kinds of schemes, she claimed to be the male lead’s henchman and lived flat on her stomach…
“Next time, if something untoward happens to you, tell me right away.”
Why was it that her uncle, who she haven’t seen a few times in the novel, and…
“Will you be able to bring me tea so often in the future?”
…her grandfather, who she thought he hated her,
“The prince has a more handsome face and a better personality than I do. Do you really think so?!”
Her cousin’s brother, who was like an enemy, pretended to be a family member who didn’t fit in
“You just need to be by my side.”
Even the male lead’s obsession that had turned around even more than the original!
She didn’t want to mortgage her life to a psychopath!
‘Let me just blow it up!’

67249.synopsis:
Estella, the most powerful saint in history.
A woman whom God adores and loves.
On the day of Estella’s coronation, the pope receives a revelation from God to attach a paladin by her side.
Michelle, her stoic paladin who would spend the rest of his life protecting her.
As Estella reaches her adolescence, she becomes fascinated by her knight Michelle, who had been by her side since she was very young…
When she finally reaches adulthood and is free to pursue her love affairs, she attempts her courtship of him. Boldly! Cutely! Cunningly!
God did not label love and conception a sin.
‘Any man who sleeps alone on the night of St. Chocolatier’s is a eunuch.’
It was a random day during the cold winter when such a famous saying came down like a legendary divination.
If you give chocolate to someone you like during this day, your feelings will be reciprocated!
Estella presents Michelle with her heartfelt chocolate.
Oblivious to the rum that was mixed alongside the chocolate ingredients she had attempted to give the chocolate for the first time in her life.
***
Oh, oh my god!
Michelle lay motionless in bed, staring blankly into the distance.
He was desperately trying his best not to look at the cute being sitting on top of him.
“Michelle, look at me too.”
How can I, when I know exactly what’s going to occur the moment that happens.
“Does Michelle really hate me? Even if I do this, do I still look like a child?”
Michelle stubbornly stared into the air, trying his best not to concentrate below him. Until a cute little bu*t pressed down on his testicles.
“Hyuk.”
He couldn’t do it anymore. No matter how much Michelle had taken refuge in God, he could not ignore the direct physical stimulation.
So, God, forgive your ugly sheep.

67505.synopsis:
When Xu Yue woke up, he found that he had become a monster.
To the left, there were two slimes—the old couple next door. To the right, there was a young dragon—the junior high school student downstairs. They all met and were equally bewildered by their different races.
It wasn’t until Xu Yue accidentally opened his personal status bar.
(Former) Game Developer Xu Yue: ……
His game successfully launched, but something seemed off.

68785.synopsis:
Wu Su was a demon born from chaos. Due to her low magical powers, she was often mistaken for an ordinary mortal. Nonetheless, she was content living as an average person, hidden in the bustling capital of the mortal world, working three jobs a day to support herself.
Later, due to an unexpected event, a night of revelry, she coincidentally ended up with a mortal husband.
Although he was just a mortal and their social statuses were vastly different, he was persistently attached to Wu Su. She didn’t understand romantic love and thought that she would wait for him to tire of her before leaving.
But one day, a celestial being came from the Immortal Island and spoke of her husband’s extraordinary talent for cultivation.
Wu Su thought, “Now he must be leaving, going to his world beyond the mortal realm, to cultivate his heartless path.” However, unexpectedly, her husband drove the celestial being away.
Wu Su was stunned for three days.
One night, he kissed Wu Su’s lips. His lips were cold, but his eyes burned with determination. Wu Su tilted her head, embraced him, and following the celestial being’s instructions, severed the emotional bond with her husband.
He forgot about her, and Wu Su left, continuing to live as an ordinary little monster, working three jobs a day.
Later on, Wu Su became involved in a big demon’s disturbance, wrongly accused as the instigator, and was captured by the cultivators from the Immortal Island.
Wu Su was brought before the ruler of the Immortal Island, the number one Sword Supreme in the world. She lowered her head and saw someone walking slowly towards her, wearing a simple and old sachet at his waist.
On the sachet were intertwined mandarin ducks, a gift that Wu Su had personally sewn for her husband a long time ago.
associated_names: After Abandoning the Heartless Dao Sword Venerable

69297.synopsis:
Isabel, who had lost her parents, was being pampered by her brothers. She heard that her brother’s friend, Evan, whom she had a crush on for a long time, was getting married.
Not wanting to let him go, Isabel declared that Evan had been rude to her and needed to be apologized with a kiss…
“Are you done?… I’m ready.”
“Ready for an apology?”
“…Yes”
Isabel answered shyly. She gracefully tilted her head, causing her waist-length, wispy blonde hair to fall forward and cover her immaculate chest.
Evan frowned. He rose from his seat and moved toward her.
“Wh-what? What are you doing?”
As he finally sat down next to her, Isabel became nervous. It was her first time being this close to a man.
“Quiet, I’m going to apologize.”
Isabel then squeezed her eyes shut, anticipating a passionate apology. Her innocent heart fluttered at the thought of being kissed by her longtime crush.

72113.synopsis:
Cooking skills?
That could be easily overwhelmed simply through the power of the ingredients.
It’s time.
It’s time to show these people, who are unaware of the reality, the might of a higher world.
—————————————————————————————————————
Summary: A boy that had transmigrated into the world of Shokugeki no Soma faced his biggest problem yet. His farm estate was being placed as a wager in a Shokugeki, yet none of the chefs were willing to help him face off against a Totsuki Graduate. As a final resort, he decided to pass through a door to another world, Toriko, to save himself and find the countless phantasmical ingredients. There, he brings countless never-seen-before ingredients back to world of Shokugeki no Soma.
associated_names: 穿越食戟的我，能前往美食的俘虏

73905.synopsis:
Xiao Luolan and her beloved daughter attended a Huazhang Hanfu Lotus Festival event. Suddenly, in the blink of an eye, her daughter disappeared. As she frantically searched for her daughter, a kind-hearted stranger unexpectedly appeared to help her…
Xiao Qingxue had transmigrated. Upon opening her eyes, the first thing she saw was her mother, eyes red and swollen from crying, looking like a pear blossom bathed in rain, and behind her stood a tall, imposing middle-aged man.
Turmoil and conflict had already erupted. Initially, Xiao Qingxue thought she and her mother were starting in hell.
But to her utter surprise, it turned out her mother was the one with the protagonist’s script in this story.

74417.synopsis:
In one year, humanity’s Savior Kamishiro Fuuka—will die.
And yet one day, during our first meeting no less, she approached me.
“Please go out with me.”
As her boyfriend, it now became my duty to go through all sorts of events and plans she marked in her ‘Savior Notebook’ until the day she will die. Meeting in spring, checking out the summer fireworks, the cultural festival in fall, running away during the cold winter…
The more memories we built together, the easier I realized—that she was still just a normal girl. So could I, the strongest shadow user and hunter of humanity’s evil, possibly save her before it’s too late?
associated_names: I’m Humanity’s Savior. Well, I’ll be Dead in One Year
私、救世主なんだ。まぁ、一年後には死んでるんだけどね

“Orange Storm Warning” refers to the possibility of strong winds or heavy rainfall with an average wind force of 10 or above within the next 12 hours, influenced by tropical cyclones. It can also indicate that an area is already affected by a tropical cyclone with an average wind force of 10-11 or gusts reaching 11-12, and this condition may persist.*
In such weather, Fang Xing encountered Jiang Zhijin, who had just finished a fight with someone, outside the hospital’s emergency room. At that moment, Fang Xing thought, “Why is this person so irritating?” Little did he know that Jiang Zhijin had similar thoughts.
Fang Xing x Jiang Zhijin
A story about two cool guys who can’t stand each other but end up living together and even fall in love. 
The age difference between them is 10 years, with the younger one being the top!!

1. 10-year age difference, 18 and 28;

75953.synopsis:
A world where the game system is default.

Aine’s level was only 7.
Growing up alone in a small village on the outskirts, she barely lived through beginner monster hunting and she thought she would continue to do so for the rest of her life… .
[Caught by a rare Thorong curse]
[Curse intensity: S grade]
Life has changed since being cursed.
The pain that comes every night.
Her priest said to her that she was having a hard time.
‘If you have a relationship with someone with strong divine power or drink their blood… The curse may be purified.’
A person with mighty divine power.
Like a warrior, for example.
So Aine hides her intentions and she approaches the warriors… .

76209.synopsis:
It’s only natural to want to be bullied by a girl, the boss of an evil organization that controls the underworld. He harbored a secret that he absolutely couldn’t share with anyone.
The cross he bore to keep that secret hidden.
And the cross he bears is not the only thing…
His yandere subordinate knows his secret. The three magical girls aim to thwart his evil deeds.
You’re about to see a world of chaos and disorder that can never be witnessed in the open.
If you’re prepared, let’s peek into the hidden world.
associated_names: 頼むから俺の前にいる女は泣き叫ばないでください〜ヤンデレ部下と3馬鹿魔法少女は俺の邪魔をするな〜

77489.synopsis:
Feng Ming was reborn in a different world with his memories. His biological father was a famous cultivator in Qingyun City who ran the large Feng family. As his father’s only… ger, Feng Ming enjoyed all the love. Even if his cultivation aptitude wasn’t that good, he felt that this life would be a life of lying down and winning. He could even accept the possibility of laying eggs in the future.
Feng Ming, who was living a happy life, was almost knocked unconscious by a sudden marriage contract. The man who was about to marry into his family was a proud son of heaven, but his dantian was destroyed and he was turned into a useless person. He was betrayed and abandoned by everyone. Feng Ming touched his head and thought about it. Wasn’t this the usual setting of the novels he usually read in his previous life? If the male protagonist became his husband, would he be cut down by the male protagonist in the future?’
Feng Ming trembled and went to welcome his spouse. However, at first sight, Feng Ming was almost stunned by the appearance of his new husband. He happily welcomed the other person into Old Feng’s house.
associated_names: The Time Traveler’s House Has a Rich Son-in-Law

78769.synopsis:
Haruna Sato, 19 years old, once a college student, finished his byte and was eating evening with his mother • sister • and aunt. At that time, a magic circle appeared on the floor , and they were summoned to a different world. It was a different world, where humans and demons are fighting. And the Sato family was summoned by the royalty who united the humans as their savior. But there are more confusing things than that. that is …..
「 Haru！I seem to be rejuvenating like I am a high school girl! 」
My family, including my mother, is rejuvenating and everyone has become like a high school student.
And said the magical abilities that I met when I was summoned 【strengthen the partner’s ability by doing naughty acts with the partner】
associated_names: 異世界転移した結果、母と同級生になりました

80561.synopsis:
After returning from the cultivation world, I went back to my hometown to farm, live-stream, and sell vegetables!  
Having failed to transcend tribulation and attain the Golden Core, Song Tan returned to the modern world only to find herself at the scene of a multiple car accident. Saved by a kind stranger, she narrowly escaped death. What more was there to consider? She decided not to be a corporate s*ave and went back home to farm instead! Utilizing her cultivation experience, Song Tan created an idyllic pastoral landscape—harvesting wild vegetables, cooking country meals, picking cucumbers, live streaming, and selling rare mountain delicacies…     
[True farming, the real deal]
[There’s a male lead, but his role is limited]

81585.synopsis:
I like my sugar daddy.
To win his heart, I strive to be a good canary.
But he remains cold and distant toward me.
Until I discovered, he has another canary.
He only becomes infatuated, shy, and nervous around her.
Heartbroken, I stripped my sugar daddy and tied him up.
… Then I ran away.
A year later, we met again at a blind date, very awkward.
He squinted at me: “Like tying people up?”
“Come on, tie me as much as you want.”

82609.synopsis:
In her previous life, Qin Ke’s sister was married to the eldest son of the Huo family, Huo Zhonglou. However, upon discovering his disfigurement, she fled on the wedding night.
Qin Ke was deceived by her foster parents into marrying Huo Zhonglou as a substitute.
Later, she was like a beauty hidden in the golden house by him, schemed against by her sister into becoming disabled, and could not escape from that man until her death.
Returning to the age of 16, she is determined to rewrite her destiny.
Qin Ke changed her high school preference and entered Qiande High School, but she met Huo Jun there.
Huo Jun has a paranoid personality, unpredictable mood, and everyone in Qiande High School is afraid of him, except for Qin Ke. In her previous life, she had seen his most ferocious side, risking his life to save her.
Huo Jun is indifferent to everyone, but he is extremely tolerant and doting towards Qin Ke. Qin Ke decides to reluctantly accept him.
Qin Ke: “Let’s set three rules.”
Huo Jun: “You say.”
Qin Ke: “No madness, no fierceness, no hooliganism.”
Huo Jun l**ked the corner of his mouth and laughed in a hoarse voice.
“Okay.”
Huo Jun began to behave.
The whole school was shocked, and Qin Ke was very satisfied.
Until she suddenly discovered that Huo Jun was Huo Zhonglou before his disfigurement.
Qin Ke was scared and ran away.
Huo Jun pulled her back, blocked her in the small woods in the school, and laughed in a paranoid and desperate manner—
“I’ve changed like this, and you still don’t like me?”
“No…”
“What else do you want?”
“…” Qin Ke was quiet for two seconds, carefully raised a finger tip, “Add one more.”
“Add what.”
“Don’t… don’t play ‘beauty hidden in the golden house’ with me in the future?”
****
In her previous life, Qin Ke was like a blank sheet of paper. She had never had a first love and was “married” into the Huo family. All her little tempers and habits were pampered by Huo Zhonglou. Every inch of her was according to his wishes. In this life, those details are deeply ingrained and unchanged, even if only remnants remain, they hook Huo Jun to death.
Later, Huo Jun loved her to the extreme and asked through gritted teeth, “Who else have you been with before me?”
Qin Ke watched him go crazy, and only laughed in his ear, “…guess?”

82865.synopsis:
Ye Rongxu has a delicate appearance and was born sickly, making him the darling of the entire family.
In an accident, he awakened self-consciousness and discovered that he was a beautiful villain in a revenge novel. Although he was beautiful, he had to sit in a wheelchair due to illness and disability. This has caused his personality to become vicious and gloomy. He offended the male protagonist in the early stage and later suffered a terrible retaliation.
The male protagonist Qin Chaoyan, who was originally his fiancé’s younger brother, has a cold and gloomy personality. His father doesn’t care about him and his mother doesn’t love him. During that time, he accidentally touched his wheelchair, and caused him to fall into the water and be hospitalized. As a result, Qin Chaoyan was sent to Ye Rongxu to vent his anger.
During this period in the book, he made things difficult for the male protagonist, humiliated him viciously, and even made him kneel down.
Later on, the other party achieved success and fame. Knowing that Ye Rongxu liked his brother, he forced Ye Rongxu to marry himself instead and tortured him, making the already sick and weak young man so angry that he died.
After learning about the plot, Ye Rongxu’s sickly profile looked to the front of the wheelchair.
Qin Chaoyan’s thin and bony spine was being pressed to his knees by the bodyguard, and his chest was being stepped on in humiliation.
According to the routine, he should quickly please the other party to avoid the future ending, but…
Ye Rongxu coughed softly, his throat was fishy and sweet, and his delicate eyebrows dropped slightly: What are you doing? Why don’t you help me massage my feet?
After saying this, he threw the male lead a map of the acupoints on the soles of his feet that he had just gotten from Baidu.
Put aside other things for now, he’s dying, and he needs to start taking care of his health.
associated_names: 反派病美人开始养生了

83121.synopsis:
Nero, the disabled and ruthless villainous tyrant Alpha in the famous tragic novel The Passion of the Holy Son, wakes up to find himself bound to a system.
System: Maintain your tyrant persona + accumulate Hatred Points from the protagonist tops + be killed by the joint efforts of the protagonist tops to complete the task. Failure will trigger a random plot punishment.
Nero: …
Nero: Oh.
To complete the task as soon as possible, Nero brings his targets back to the capital in advance.
For instance, he finds Big Boss A in a dangerous exile, pardons his crimes, and pushes him step by step to a commanding position, yet demands his Omega sister as a trade for status, deeply humiliating Big Boss A.
He rescues Big Boss B from the prison cage of star pirates and forces him to wear the empire’s most elite heavy armor to fight the hardest battles, never showing him a kind face in the imperial court.
He takes away Big Boss C when everyone scorns him, but sends him to the front lines with ample scientific resources, denying him the luxury of being the empire’s prime minister.
As for Big Boss D, who grew up with Nero, he initially doesn’t know how to provoke his hatred.
Until he discovers that every time the Holy Son, the protagonist bottom, blesses him with a kiss, the Hatred Points of the big bosses soar.
So he immediately hooks the Holy Son’s neck, deciding to get more kisses from the protagonist bottom.
System, weeping with joy: Host, the Hatred Points are skyrocketing! This host is amazing.jpg
Nero is also very satisfied: Holy Son, very useful.jpg
The day the Hatred Points finally maxed out, the system was happily preparing to wrap things up. However, the key plots of revenge and defeat had not occurred.
The silver-haired emperor stood atop the peak of the mecha, proudly overlooking the defeated invaders. His crimson cloak was drenched in blood, yet it shone a million times brighter than the sun of Delphi.
System: …How could this happen! Major plot deviation warning! Random plot punishment warning!
Nero smiled: What kind of punishment will it be, I wonder?
Just as he finished speaking, his differentiation period ended.
Confirmed countless times by the imperial medical officers to be the future powerful Alpha of the empire, the emperor silently and stoically differentiated into a top-tier Omega amid the fervent gazes and cheers of billions of subjects.
Secret pheromones wafted down from the throne. Four pairs of seemingly submissive eyes suddenly widened.
—In their eyes, a scarlet thirst appeared.
***
You are the rose on the high branch
You are the molten gold in the fire
One day I will use the most extravagant golden chains
To imprison you in the cage that belongs to me.
associated_names: 烈火熔金 (暴君分化成omega以后)

83633.synopsis:
A world filled with anomalies, monsters, and superhumans, and a bureau that manages and contains them.
I am an office worker there with slightly better eyesight.
At least, I have been until now.
associated_names: An Office Worker at the Anomaly Management Bureau (Novelpia Global)

83889.synopsis:
“You have become the crown prince’s partner. So, you should smile.”
Assad, the crown prince of the Helio Empire, takes a foreigner as his partner according to an oracle.
However, since the engagement is forced, he wants to break it off.
Eventually, to discover the weaknesses of his bride, Kaiden, he disguises himself as the attendant ‘Amun’ and approaches him…
“Thank you, Amun. I’m sorry I have nothing to give to someone as kind as you.”
“…”
“I wish I were someone who had more.”
Somehow, the more he meets with Kaiden, the more he can’t deny his feelings are shaken by his timid but kind bride.
Especially after impulsively spending the night with Kaiden.
“I told you not to come, but you came. Even if you change your mind and say you don’t want to, you can’t take it back.”
“…”
“You, take responsibility for me.”
You took my first time.

85425.synopsis:
Ye Feng crossed over to a parallel world where games were scarce. He obtained a game development system that increased his game-making abilities based on players rating his games as “super difficult.” However, the feedback he received was consistently “very easy.” Determined to challenge this, he introduced a series of notoriously hard games from his previous world, such as *Getting Over It*, *Dead Cells*, *Bloodborne*, and *Sekiro*. Despite players being frustrated and broken in spirit, they still unwaveringly chose the “very easy” option!
->Game Design: Who Rated the Games as Very Easy?
associated_names: 游戏设计：就你们填非常简单？

85681.synopsis:
The legitimate daughter of the Jiang family from the Duke’s household, Jiang Ruohua, recently had a dream in which her relentless pursuit of perfection led to a tragic end. Her fiancé, Prince Ying, loved someone else. For the sake of her family’s and the Jiang family’s honor, she constantly gave way, only to be used and then betrayed, leading to a disastrous fate for herself and her family.
What she thought was just a nightmare started to come true. Realizing it was real, she decided to kick the s*umbag to the curb first!
With the engagement annulled, her perfect life seemed within reach, but then her ex-fiancé suddenly came looking for her.
“…Woman, don’t think you can annul our engagement!”
[Ah, is this the female lead? She looks eight hundred times better than that Zhao girl! Wife! I want her to be my wife!]
Besides the usual cold and arrogant words, Jiang Ruohua thought she heard some other unreliable voice.
Dressed up for a palace banquet, her ex-fiancé sneered, “Hmph, nothing special!”
[Marry me now! System, I don’t want to do tasks anymore, I want her as my wife!]
When disaster struck, and refugees flooded into the capital, she provided porridge for them. Her ex-fiancé sneered, “Pretending to be kind!”
[I’m losing it! How can my warm lips speak such cold words to my kind and beautiful wife! The plot is all over the place, why do I still have to follow it! System, I’m going to fight you!]
Jiang Ruohua wondered what kind of idiot she had released by breaking the engagement. How did she end up with such a two-faced fool by her side? Annoying!
1v1, both pure. Dominant, cunning reborn female lead x Tsundere idiot male lead from a book.
associated_names: 会读心后，男主的恋爱脑藏不住了

86193.synopsis:
Original Synopsis: In this world, humans and contracted objects coexist. Swords, spears, sabers, and halberds; firewood, rice, oil, and salt; water, fire, wind; pigs, dogs, oxen, and even sheep can all become contracted objects.
Handwritten synopsis of this novel: They do not know their past glory. They do not know their past power. They’ve been destroyed time and time again. They have no free will. They think themselves powerful while fighting for their own interests. Those higher beings make sure of it. They are born with contracts yet they don’t know the meaning behind them. They’ve long forgotten what it means to be “Human”. Our protagonist a young man named Zhanyue just wanted to finish his PhD and live a leisurely life. Unfortunately, he found himself transported to a turbulent world where everyone had already been cultivating since they were young while those Evil beings had already been living for hundreds of years. Cases of old Monsters who wouldn’t die possessing weaklings souls were all too common. And to make matters worse the humans in this world were heading towards a world ending war with something called the “Nightmare” Race. Wait that’s not the worst of it!?

86449.synopsis:
This is a daily mystery about nine rather unusual members of a certain chemistry club, who sometimes solve and sometimes don’t solve various incidents such as suspicious person uproars, thefts, the origin of love letters, and the fate of adult magazines.
*This is a spin-off of “The Maid Will Go On Through Thick And Thin!” but there’s no problem if you haven’t read the main story. In fact, it might be more enjoyable as a mystery if you don’t know it.*

87473.synopsis:
Bo Xinghang has always been a free spirit, exuding an aura that warns people not to mess with him. The school didn’t want to give up on such a promising student, but he was too wild to be tamed.
Then, in a surprising turn of events, he changed his ways all on his own.
Everyone: ???
He thought this was how his life would be until he met Doctor Ji, and suddenly, his whole world lit up.
On the day the college entrance exams ended, the entire class was gathered together in celebration. No one noticed that the coolest and most handsome guy in class, Hang-ge, got caught smoking and was pinned against the wall by his “gege,” punished with a kiss that left him breathless.
When the kiss left him weak-kneed and his mind blank, Doctor Ji pressed closer, his indifferent monolid eyes slightly lowered as he softly coaxed him:
“Be good.”
Later, the two of them made a rule:
For every cigarette he smoked, he’d get a kiss.
Damn.
Bo Xinghang cursed under his breath, blushing, “How am I supposed to quit like this…”

88241.synopsis:
As a noble young lady from the Boling Cui family, Cui Yunzhao never imagined that when she proposed a divorce, Huo Tan would dare to agree so readily.
Of course, their marriage were forced due to the selfish desires of Cui Yunzhao’s uncle, who forced the match.
A marriage like that was better off avoided. No matter how capable he was or how respected he was as a young general in Bo Ling, he was still a rough man from a military background. He rarely spoke kindly and had no understanding of cherishing women.
Just thinking about it exhausted Cui Yunzhao, it was better to end it sooner.
After the divorce, Huo Tan soared higher and became the revered young emperor everyone admired, while Cui Yunzhao became a laughingstock throughout Bianjing.
Cui Yunzhao lived alone in a villa far away from Bianjing, thinking that she would live a peaceful life like this, but the most poisonous drug in the world took her life in advance.
In her final moments of agony, she heard a voice saying softly, “That person’s heart is truly ruthless.”
At that time, Cui Yunzhao felt her life had been absurdly ridiculous. If she could have a second chance, she would live this life to the fullest.
When she opens her eyes again, Cui Yunzhao finds herself back on the night of her wedding to Huo Tan.
Seeing the man’s strong, lean figure, she narrows her fox-like eyes and pushes him into the bridal chamber.
Since this man is destined to rise, she will use him as her tool.
She is determined to uncover everything from her previous life, find out who killed her, and live this life to the fullest!
On the wedding night, with her snow-like skin and flower-like red lips, her sweet fragrance fills Huo Tan’s nose.
She looks down at him from a high vantage.
“This time, you fell into my hands.”
The young general was handsome and unparalleled, gazes deeply at the stunning beauty before him, his eyes holding nothing else.
“Let’s see who ends up in whose hands,” he replies.

90033.synopsis:

“Want to get the marriage certificate? Honey, let’s do it today.”

90545.synopsis:
In an era where human advancement stagnates, mankind faces devastating defeat in a galaxy-wide struggle against countless alien races. Amid internal chaos and external threats, a shocking discovery emerges through a broadcast program—a peerless genius named Jiang Que, exiled on a forsaken planet. 
Jiang Que develops revolutionary cultivation techniques that not only transform various human industries but also offer a path to extending lifespans and evolving into higher beings. As humanity deploys every strategy to steal his secrets, alien factions and their traitorous agents stop at nothing to sabotage his progress.

91057.synopsis:
